image_description: A low-resolution image of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. The background consists of textured, multicolored coral and rock formations.
